provider_usage_nonnegative.name: provider_usage_nonnegative
provider_usage_nonnegative.value: "provider_usage"."input_units" >= 0 and "provider_usage"."output_units" >= 0 and "provider_usage"."cost_micros" >= 0 and ("provider_usage"."latency_ms" is null or "provider_usage"."latency_ms" >= 0)

runs_step_presence.name: runs_step_presence
runs_step_presence.value: ("runs"."status" = 'queued' and "runs"."current_step" is null) or ("runs"."status" <> 'queued' and "runs"."current_step" is not null)

step_executions_lease_matches_status.name: step_executions_lease_matches_status
step_executions_lease_matches_status.value:
("step_executions"."status" in ('leased', 'running') and "step_executions"."lease_token" is not null and "step_executions"."lease_owner" is not null and "step_executions"."lease_expires_at" is not null)
    or ("step_executions"."status" not in ('leased', 'running') and "step_executions"."lease_token" is null and "step_executions"."lease_owner" is null and "step_executions"."lease_expires_at" is null)

step_executions_completion_matches_statu.name: step_executions_completion_matches_status
step_executions_completion_matches_statu.value:
("step_executions"."status" = 'succeeded' and "step_executions"."completed_at" is not null)
    or ("step_executions"."status" <> 'succeeded' and "step_executions"."completed_at" is null)
